name: ChooChooTracker
description: A portable music tracker combining classic sound chips, modern synth engines and samples.
author: ChooChooTracker contributors

changelog.v1.0.23-alpha: Add Layer instruments, Stereo Width, master EQ, technical EQ presets, animated backgrounds, a Chain minimap, Sintered gate mode and 64 MIDI CC mappings. Improve audio performance, Android background playback, and NextUI controls, suspend and battery reporting.
changelog.v1.0.22-alpha: Fix unresponsive controls on NextUI, restore native gamepad bindings for existing installations, and match the TrimUI button labels.
changelog.v1.0.21-alpha: Initial NextUI release for TrimUI Brick and Smart Pro.
